entry_sequence.transcript_quote: you might have a long idea for your session
entry_sequence.action: For long, start with a pre-existing long session bias; for short, start with a pre-existing short session bias.
entry_sequence.rationale: VWAP is used as a context filter, not a standalone signal.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait until the price has gone at least to the first if not the second standard deviation
entry_sequence.action: For long, wait for price to extend away from VWAP to at least the first, ideally the second, upper standard-deviation band; for short, wait for price to extend to at least the first, ideally the second, lower standard-deviation band.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup wants price stretched away from fair value before continuation confirmation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: after we broke it and tested it we can try our long trade
entry_sequence.action: For long, enter after price breaks back above the selected VWAP band and retests it; for short, enter after price breaks back below the selected VWAP band and retests it.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break-and-retest is the continuation trigger after the extension.

targets.transcript_quote: you can use the second and third standard deviation as a Target
targets.rationale: The speaker says to use the second standard deviation as a target.

targets.transcript_quote: you can use the second and third standard deviation as a Target
targets.rationale: The speaker says to use the third standard deviation as a target.
